name: Παραλία Έδεμ
round1Evidence: Deck chairs/parasols and bars available; hotel rents sunbeds (~15€/person, 2023), rest of beach free with free toilets/showers.

name: Γαλάζια Ακτή
round1Evidence: Beach bar with sunbeds; entrance/sunbed pricing quoted (weekday minimum consumption 3€, sunbed 2.50€). Note: sources reference both Lagonisi and Schinias 'Galazia Akti' — both organized.

name: Κεντρική παραλία Σαρωνίδας
round1Evidence: Central Saronida beach has 'umbrellas placed by the municipality'; the named beach bars (Alexander, Mavro Lithari) are on adjacent beaches, not the central one.

name: Σουβάλα
round1Evidence: Souvala beach offers sunbeds, umbrellas, a beach bar and restaurant; nearby Loura beach also organized with umbrellas/sunbeds.

name: Αυλάκι
round1Evidence: Small pebble beach with cement sunbathing platform; umbrellas-sunbeds plus coffee/drinks/food provided by Castello housed directly above the beach.

name: Λιμνιώνας
round1Evidence: Undeveloped and quiet overall, but 'σε ένα μόνο μικρό τμήμα υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες' and there is a small snack-bar.

name: Κομπονάδα
round1Evidence: In summer the beach has a canteen and sunbeds on one section ('διαθέτει καντίνα και ξαπλώστρες σε ένα κομμάτι της').

name: Μικρή Ζωγεριά
round1Evidence: Zogeria bay, NW Spetses, has two coves; guides (argosaronikos.gr, travelgo) place the taverna and the rented umbrella/sunbed sets (10€/σετ) in the bay, with the small cove specifically holding the taverna and sunbeds. Caveat: some sources describe the bay as a whole, so attribution to the small cove is good but not airtight.

name: Παραλία Πόρτο Γερμενό
round1Evidence: Mostly free beach, but a small part is organized with umbrellas and loungers and the Punda Loca beach bar maintains loungers with umbrellas on the beach.

name: Άγιος Αντώνιος
round1Evidence: psahno.com (local Psachna Evia guide): 'Η παραλία είναι οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες' with cafeterias, beach bars and tavernas; some boilerplate-reuse risk noted.

name: Άγιος Μηνάς
round1Evidence: eviagreece: organized beach 3km from Chalkida offering umbrellas with loungers or cafes, popular with families; many tavernas/restaurants around.

name: Ζέφυρος
round1Evidence: Disambiguated from the Rhodes namesake: Zefiros is the cafe/beach bar ON the Nea Artaki beach (eviagreece.gr item, e-chalkida video 'Παραλία Ζέφυρος - Νέα Αρτάκη'). Sources on the Nea Artaki beachfront describe beachfront bars with umbrellas and sunbeds (extra charge for sunbeds on weekends), with Zefiros named as the beachfront venue at this spot.

name: Παραλία Δάφνης
round1Evidence: Disambiguated to Dafni Nerotrivias (west-coast central Evia, matches pin 38.63/23.49; the other Dafni is at Chiliadou on the Aegean side). eviaportal's beach-specific page: a seasonal 'beach bar με εστιατόριο' operates on the first section and 'βγάζει μερικές ομπρέλες' when open, plus a taverna on the second section — but it advises bringing your own gear and never mentions ξαπλώστρες. Beach bar confirmed; sunbeds unconfirmed and organization is partial/seasonal.

name: Παραλία Κρύας Βρύσης
round1Evidence: North-Evia (Agia Anna extension) Krya Vrysi is described as 'οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες' with a shop on the beach serving coffee/ouzo; note there is also a Krya Vrysi near Karystos.

name: Παραλία Φάρου
round1Evidence: Official bathing-water profile for Faros Avlidas: 'Τμήμα της παραλίας είναι οργανωμένο και διαθέτει... ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' — assuming our Paralia Farou is the Avlida one (lighthouse at NE end).

name: Σουβάλα
round1Evidence: Disambiguated from the Aegina namesake: our pin matches Πλαζ Σουβάλα at Chalkida's north port (YouTube 'Χαλκίδα Παραλία (Πλαζ Σουβάλα)', egnomi coverage, official bathing-water profile GRBW079155162). The bathing-water profile states part of the beach is organized with permanent umbrellas, showers and bins (municipal-style). No sunbed-rental or beach-bar evidence.

name: Τσοκαΐτι
round1Evidence: eviagreece: Tsokaiti (Istiaia) has 'organized areas with loungers'; in earlier years canteens and beach bars provided loungers and umbrellas — present-tense sunbeds claimed, bar status uncertain.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Μηνά
round1Evidence: Locality certain: Agios Minas at Genimakia, Desfina — the Corinthian-gulf cove between Chiliadou and Monastiraki, matching our pin. The local municipal-community site e-desfina.gr states a canteen with the emblematic name «Ο ΑΓΙΟΣ» operates on the beach offering everything 'από νερό μέχρι ξαπλώστρα'. This local, beach-specific source outweighs the generic 'δεν θα βρεις beach bar ή ομπρέλες' guide line; sunbeds are canteen-run and seasonal, no beach bar.

name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
round1Evidence: Viotia beach guide: Agios Nikolaos has a large sandy beach where 'all day bar restaurants have set up umbrellas and loungers on the beach' with showers and food; reservation needed on August weekends.

name: Megali Ammos
round1Evidence: Megali Ammos (Ammouliani, Halkidiki): 'partially organized, featuring sunbeds and umbrellas, complemented by a tavern and a beach bar' — sunbeds via two beach bars (15€/set 2024 or free with order).

name: Λύκος
round1Evidence: Unambiguous locality: Lykos/Likkos bay, Sfakia south coast between Loutro and Marmara (matches lat/lng). Taverna Akrogiali sits directly on Lykos beach and its listings state it 'offers sunbeds'; Georgoshouse (also on the bay) advertises free sunbeds and hammocks adjoining the beach. Sunbeds are taverna/guesthouse-provided rather than a concession, and cretanbeaches confirms only tavernas with rooms — no beach bar.

name: Παραλία Θανάσης
round1Evidence: Pinned via lat/lng to the western beach of Stavros, Akrotiri Chania — documented as 'beach near Taverna Thanasis, Stavros, Akrotiri peninsula' (Alamy caption confirms the name/place pairing). Multiple guides (cretanbeaches, elizabethestateagency) state Stavros has two sandy beaches 'organized with canteens, umbrellas and sun beds'. Sunbeds inferred for this specific (Thanasis/western) beach from that two-beach statement, hence not high confidence.

name: Άγιος Γεώργιος
round1Evidence: At the eastern cove (Lichnistis) of Agios Georgios near Agia Galini there are rooms, a small taverna and umbrellas; area otherwise quiet/semi-wild.

name: Σπήλιες
round1Evidence: Spilies (Latzima, east of Rethymno) 'is organized with sunbeds, umbrellas and a canteen'.

name: Βουρλιά
round1Evidence: Lat/lng matches Vourlia, the central-settlement beach of Xerokambos. Cretanbeaches (a reputable Crete guide, upgrading round-1's 'low-quality map listing') describes the Vourlia settlement beach as 'αρκετά οργανωμένη' (fairly organized) and lists umbrellas among the beach's amenities; tavernas are in the settlement. No explicit sunbed count, hence sunbeds left null and confidence medium.

name: Χιόνα Παλαίκαστρου
round1Evidence: Unambiguous locality (Chiona, 2 km from Palaikastro, Sitia — matches lat/lng). Resolving the round-1 conflict: cretazine and crete-today both state the beach has 'λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' (a few sunbeds and umbrellas) plus tamarisks, and famous fish tavernas directly on the beach (e.g. Chiona tavern). So lightly but genuinely organized: few sunbeds yes, no beach bar.

name: Άη Γιαννάκης
round1Evidence: Ai Giannakis on the Parga–Preveza road, 6 km before Parga (matches lat/lng). Two dedicated pages (taxidologio.gr, travelpreveza.gr) state it is 'οργανωμένη, με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες και θαλάσσια σπορ' with food businesses very close. One round-1 source claimed only a canteen above the beach; the more specific dedicated beach pages win, but the conflict caps confidence at medium.

name: Παντοκράτορας
round1Evidence: Pantokratoras town beach, 2.5 km from Preveza centre (matches lat/lng). Official/local sources (visitpreveza.gr, prevezaguide) state the beach has some umbrellas and showers, free sunbeds for bathers, and a restaurant and cafeteria right by the sea. Minimal but explicit on-beach organization; the food venues are beside the beach, not a beach bar.

name: Παραλία Λυγιάς
round1Evidence: travelpreveza.gr: beach described as not fully organized, but businesses on the beach offer free sunbeds and umbrellas for their customers.

name: Παραλία Καλάμι
round1Evidence: Visit Thesprotia: the adjacent camping provides sunbeds where you can enjoy coffee/snacks (Kalami between Igoumenitsa and Plataria).

name: Glyfa Beach
round1Evidence: SuperTravel/projectcorfu: Glyfa (between Barbati and Nissaki, NE coast) has sunbeds & umbrellas, boat hire and a taverna restaurant.

name: Μώλος
round1Evidence: Lovin' Corfu/discover-corfu: Molos (Lefkimmi Bay) is partly organized around the Attika Resort with sunbeds/umbrellas for rent, showers and a beach bar-restaurant; rest is unorganized.

name: Αγία Παρασκευή
round1Evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr/terrabook: Agia Paraskevi (between Sami and Agia Efimia) has organized spots with sunbeds and beach bars, plus the Agia Paraskevi Beach Restaurant.

name: Βάτσα
round1Evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr: Vatsa Bay offers loungers and umbrellas plus beach bars serving drinks/light meals and water sports (kayak, ski).

name: Κατσούνι
round1Evidence: Disambiguated to Psara (pin at the settlement's east side; Rhodes/Anafi namesakes excluded). Psara-specific pages (WonderGreece Psara Katsouni, greecevacationsearch Psara entry) describe it as the island's most popular sandy beach with sunbeds, WC and parking, hosting summer beach-volley tournaments. No beach bar confirmed.

name: Αμμουδέλι
round1Evidence: Lesvos beach guide: the small sandy beach 300m from Plomari square is organized with umbrellas and sun loungers and quite popular.

name: Φαρά
round1Evidence: Wikipedia (Blue Flag 2025): in summer a canteen operates at Fara offering free loungers and shade under mastic trees.

name: Χαλατσές
round1Evidence: Official bathing water profile: not formally organized but has showers, changing rooms, umbrellas and loungers plus a refreshment stand on the beach.

name: Μπάλος
round1Evidence: Balos in Ormos Koumeikon, SW Samos (pin matches; Crete namesake excluded). The official Greek bathing-water profile for this exact beach (GRBW149264276) states a section is organized with umbrellas, loungers, changing rooms and bins; samosin.gr's older 'not organized, tavernas on the road' conflicts but the official beach-specific profile is more authoritative. Tavernas are roadside, no beach bar.

name: Παραλία Μύλων
round1Evidence: Myloi beach is organized with bather facilities — umbrellas, showers, changing rooms, bins; seafront tavernas and cafes in the village.

name: Ζαρίτσι
round1Evidence: Zaritsi (Tyros) is partially organized with beach bars for coffee/drinks and tavernas; the organized Zaritsi Camping operates beside it.

name: Παραλία Βερβένων
round1Evidence: Kato Vervena / Paliochano beach: a canteen mid-beach offers plenty of loungers and umbrellas, with ample free space for own equipment.

name: Πούλιθρα
round1Evidence: Poulithra's pebble beach is partly organized — sunbeds available on a section of the beach, with tavernas along the shore.

name: Σιδερώνα
round1Evidence: Siderona near Korfos, Korinthia (pin matches). Beach-specific Greek sources: 'ανοργάνωτη, ωστόσο υπάρχει ένα ταβερνάκι ακριβώς δίπλα' whose fish taverna 'απλώνει μερικές ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω στην ακροθαλασσιά' — the taverna puts a few umbrellas and sunbeds on the shore. Sunbeds genuinely present (taverna-run, limited); no beach bar.

name: Αγία Βαρβάρα
round1Evidence: Skoutari/Agia Varvara beach (Lakonia): 'Σε κάποια σημεία θα βρείτε ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες, ενώ στην περιοχή λειτουργούν εστιατόρια και ταβέρνες' — partial sunbed coverage.

name: Παραλία Κότρωνα
round1Evidence: Kotronas is called 'one of the most well-known and organized beaches in Laconian Mani': 'There are some sun loungers and showers, and there are shops for food and coffee around the area.'

name: Πεταλίδι
round1Evidence: 'Petalidi is an organized beach with crystal-clear waters and all facilities near the village' with a promenade of tavernas and cafes; sunbeds not explicitly itemized (beach also has a Seatrac and accessibility infrastructure per our data).

name: Καμπί
round1Evidence: Kea's Kambi is described as organized mainly on its right side with umbrellas, sunbeds, showers and cabins from a beach bar, plus a taverna on the road above.

name: Παραλία Κολώνα
round1Evidence: Kythnos Kolona unambiguous (isthmus to Agios Loukas islet). Recent specific reports: one section rents umbrellas/sunbeds at €30 for 2 front-row / €20 back row, plus a taverna above the beach and a café-snack beach bar. Older guides still say 'not organized, bring equipment' — the priced, operator-specific recent account wins per recency/specificity; main sandy isthmus remains free.

name: Απόλλωνας
round1Evidence: Village beach of Apollonas described as organized with umbrellas and loungers, surrounded by tavernas and cafes.

name: Μουτσούνα
round1Evidence: The Moutsouna bay hosts two beaches, one of which is described as fully organized with sunbeds, umbrellas, lifeguard, changing rooms and showers.
